name: Owned

global_influences.artist_or_genre: Deftones, Slipknot, Queens of the Stone Age
global_influences.evidence: Drummer A.K. Samee has stated nu-metal bands including Deftones, Slipknot and Queens of the Stone Age were a large influence on the band's sound.
global_influences.source: TBS News — 'Owned' owning Dhaka's rock scene

local_adaptation_notes: Part of the mid-to-late-2000s Dhaka rock/nu-metal wave that surfaced on the RockNation festival circuit alongside AvoidRafa and Echoes.
sound_evolution_summary: Formed 2007 in Dhaka by A.K. Ratul (bass/vocals), A.K. Samee (drums) and Fasihuddin Ahmed Itmam (guitar); released two self-titled EPs, 'Owned 1' (2014) and 'Owned 2' (2017).
concert_culture_notes: Performed at 'RockNation: The Revolution of Rock' (2014) alongside other newer-generation acts AvoidRafa and Echoes.

sources.title: 'Owned' owning Dhaka's rock scene — The Business Standard
